title: single-lock automatic couplings for push tows for inland navigation, Part 1 General requirements
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down the types, material and technical requirements of the single-lock automatic couplings intended for bow-to-stern connection of vessels in push tows.
clause_3_terminology: lock automatic couplings for push tows for inland navigation

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
